system.description:
You put real weight behind every casting, enough that whatever usually shrugs off that kind of harm finds it gets through. Your spells ignore damage resistance (but not immunity).

Available to: Wizards, Clerics, Druids, Illusionists, Paladins, Magi, Bards, Sorcerers, Warlocks, Witches, Necromancers, and Artificers.

rules.value: Potent Casting: your spells ignore damage resistance (but not immunity).
